mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 76 degrees under overcast skies near the Verona Public Library. Expect an overnight low of 68 degrees with rain moving in later tonight. Under the waning gibbous moon, keep an eye out for the International Space Station at 3:29 AM, which will rise near Verona High School and head toward Madison, remaining low on the horizon.

We have two important city updates. First, September is officially Hunger Action Month in Verona, a proclamation by Mayor Luke Diaz to support the 1 in 8 residents facing food insecurity. Second, be aware of road work on Highway M this Monday and Tuesday as crews handle utility connections, which may cause some travel delays.

There is plenty to do this weekend! Today, we have the Verona Area Kids Triathlon, girls can try hockey at the Verona Ice Arena, and you can catch live music at both Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, we have yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow and trivia nights starting at the beginning of the week at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's.

In a look back at the week, police reported an incident on August 19 where officers responded to a motor vehicle crash at North Main Street and Bering Drive. Two drivers were cited following the accident, with charges including operating with a suspended license and failing to yield.
Today is the perfect day to grab a scoop of Crazy for Cookie Dough at Culver's. The shop is currently open and will be serving up treats until 10 PM tonight.
